Ensure date columns are of Date type

Source: R/utils.R
set_dates.Rd

This function takes a data.table and a vector of column names, converting the specified columns to Date type if they are not already.

Usage

set_dates(df, date_cols, date_format = NULL, reference_date = "1970-01-01")

Arguments

df

A data.table containing the data.

date_cols

A character vector of column names to be converted to Date type.

date_format

Add a possible date format to the defaults: "%Y-%m-%d", "%Y/%m/%d", "%Y%m%d"

reference_date

A string representing the origin date for numeric conversions. Default is "1970-01-01".

Value

The modified data.table with specified columns as Date type.
